> **IsRgbColor**(`includePercentValues?`, `validationOptions?`): `PropertyDecorator`

Defined in: node\_modules/.pnpm/class-validator@0.14.4/node\_modules/class-validator/types/decorator/string/IsRgbColor.d.ts:14

Check if the string is a rgb or rgba color.
`includePercentValues` defaults to true. If you don't want to allow to set rgb or rgba values with percents, like rgb(5%,5%,5%), or rgba(90%,90%,90%,.3), then set it to false.
If given value is not a string, then it returns false.

## Parameters

### includePercentValues?

`boolean`

### validationOptions?

`ValidationOptions`

## Returns

`PropertyDecorator`
